verdict.rationale: Moneybird is accounting software, so agent-driven month-end reconciliation applies to it. The pack documents an MCP channel for AI clients, but it contains no evidence of agent-run transaction matching, exception flagging, or close preparation for human review. An MCP connection to the API is only a building block for this story, not the reconciliation capability itself.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent reconcile a month end-to-end, matching transactions, flagging exceptions, and preparing the close for human review
